query: How can businesses improve Yelp user satisfaction?

per_column.name: service_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Service is a core actionable axis for improving satisfaction; the query directly benefits from per-aspect sentiment. Samples are well grounded (YLP-0002 negative, YLP-0001/0004 positive). Neutral-heavy distribution is plausible where service is unmentioned.

per_column.name: food_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Food quality is a clear improvement lever. Mostly grounded, but YLP-0003 labels food 'negative' despite 'Very good pizza... Crust cooked very well'; the size complaint is arguably value, so this reading is questionable.

per_column.name: value_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Price/value is a distinct actionable axis. YLP-0003 'value negative' is reasonably grounded in the under-$20 portion-size remark. Other silent rows correctly neutral.

per_column.name: ambiance_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Ambiance gives a genuine additional grouping axis. Values track the text well (mostly neutral when unmentioned).

per_column.name: primary_complaint
per_column.rationale: Directly identifies what to fix, highly relevant to the query. Grounding is mostly sound, but YLP-0005 mapped to 'unspecified' understates concrete complaints (cabana given away, drinks, discriminatory entry), and the NULL/'none'/unspecified inconsistency is a minor concern.

per_column.name: top_positive_driver
per_column.rationale: Highlights strengths to preserve/replicate, useful for improvement strategy and distinct from complaint. Well grounded in samples (service, general_positive).

per_column.name: satisfaction_driver
per_column.rationale: Largely a mechanical concatenation of top_positive_driver / primary_complaint into a strength:/weakness: string, so it is mostly a restatement of other added columns adding little new analytical leverage. Values are consistent with sources.

judge.rationale: The aspect-level sentiment columns plus complaint/positive-driver columns give strong, actionable axes directly aligned with 'how to improve satisfaction' — they let an analyst group and compare by service, food, value, ambiance, and identify weaknesses vs strengths. Grounding is generally sound with reasonable neutral/unknown handling for silent rows, though a few readings are shaky (YLP-0003 food negative; YLP-0005 collapsed to 'unspecified' despite concrete complaints). The satisfaction_driver column is largely redundant with two other added columns and drags usefulness down slightly, but the overall set meets both necessary conditions well.
